newsitem.title: USA: C.P. Clare sees Q2 loss, lower revenues.
newsitem.headline: C.P. Clare sees Q2 loss, lower revenues.

text.p: C.P. Clare Corp said Tuesday it anticipates a loss in its second fiscal quarter, which ends September 30 and will take a $14.75 million restructuring charge.
In light of recent market conditions, the company said revenues for the quarter are projected to be five to 10 percent below the revenues for the first quarter of this fiscal year.
The company issued a statement saying the restructuring is needed to respond to lower revenue expectations.

The company said the charge will primarily consist of the "rationalization" of worldwide reed relay facilities, including Tongeren, Belgium; Guadalajara, Mexico; Chi-Tu, Taiwan; and North Attleboro, Massachusetts.
While the company said its Advanced Magnetic Products Group is performing well, the markets for surge protectors and relays have shown softness.
The company said it also intends to make additional provisions of about $1.25 million for environmental remediation.
The company said it intends to report its results on October 24.
